changes.text: Agreed with Martin's read — reference by pin, not host, and criteria marked as authored judgment rather than recomputed fact is the shape we intended when we opened this. That answers the cross-reference question from our side: the lab holds only the criteria, everything else (families, run records, vectors) stays pinned where it already lives, including the action-ref vectors this suite already hosts. Thanks both for working through it.
